question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

At the grocery store, coffee is in __an same aisles as__ tea.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase** "an same aisles as"** is incorrect in this sentence.
 
• The **correct **phrase should be **"the same aisle as".**
 
• In English, when we compare two things being in the same location, we use "the same as&am
